description: Search the template gallery: ready-made websites, apps and starters that deploy in one step (no sign-in needed). Offer the user two or three matches with their demo links, then call get-template for the one they pick.

category.description: A kind (websites, apps, starters), or a category or group id from facets.categories in a search result (the gallery adds categories, so take ids from there); a template can be in several categories and matches any of them

framework.description: Comma list of framework ids, e.g. nextjs,astro

language.description: Comma list of languages, e.g. JavaScript,Python

query.description: Words to match, e.g. bakery, portfolio, blog

runs.description: Comma list of static, server, database (database needs a paid plan)

name: search-templates
